title: Punjab Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Land Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Land Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
PUNJAB REDEMPTION AND RESTITUTION OF MORTGAGED LAND (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged
Land Act, 1964
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001]
No. Legis.13-76/2001, dated
13-11-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Ordinance may be called
the Punjab Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Land (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall be deemed to have
come into force on and from the 14th day of August, 2001.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Land Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment in sections 2, 14, 15 and 16 of Act XIX of 1964

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
PUNJAB REDEMPTION AND RESTITUTION OF MORTGAGED LAND (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged
Land Act, 1964
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001]
No. Legis.13-76/2001, dated
13-11-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment in sections 2, 14, 15 and 16 of Act XIX of 1964.--In
the said Act, in sections 2, 14, 15 and 16 the word "Commissioner",
wherever occurring shall be substituted by the words and brackets
"Executive District Officer (Revenue)".
